components.notes: Settings (boards AdminSettings*) on the list-detail pattern: settings pages as navigation and the open page beside them. Areas add their own pages through the app; Team and roles is drawn here. It replaces the Admin roles screen.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Team controller and the settings URL seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_settings.
Team and roles (board AdminSettingsTeam): the people with an Admin job, what each of the three jobs can do, inviting by user id, and a sheet to change someone's job with a review note.

Settings → Payments: platform terms, who collects what, partner credit, tax and invoices (the GST confirmation in a CatchDialog, the next invoice number, the monthly ledger download), organizers on their own terms and plans and messaging budgets granted by hand. Change opens the editors in the detail pane. It replaces the Commercial terms, Payment routing and Finance workspaces. Previews live in admin/src/stories/AdminSettings.stories.tsx.
